changelog: Adds /nestor-beta:audit: an independent Codex or Claude agent, whose model and effort are read from plain words such as codex sol best max or claude opus best (Codex sol6.1 xhigh by default), audits a task or plan, its specification before delivery and its delivered code after, and the report is logged in a Nestor note linked to the audited item. A pull request number in place of a reference audits that pull request's changes against its description.
